ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ

uz: Ва Унга ҳеч ким тенг бўлмаган». [2]
uz_fn: [2] (Аллоҳ таолога бирор зот на зотида, на сифатида ва на амалида тенг бўлган эмас, бўлолмайди ҳам.)
ru: Он не родил и не был рождён,
en: He neither begets nor is born,
Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
en_fn: [2011] Alone, without another, indivisible with absolute and permanent unity and distinct from all else. The one and only true deity, unique in His essence, attributes and deeds.

[2012] He who is absolute, perfect, complete, essential, self-sufficient and sufficient to meet the needs of all creation; the one eternally and constantly required and sought, depended upon by all existence and to whom all matters will ultimately return.
